userBindings.summary: Two account-level (server-side) settings, synced with the Google account, not on this PC: (1) 'Keyboard shortcuts on/off' (Settings > See all settings > General), OFF until turned on, which gates every single-key verb; (2) optional custom shortcuts (Settings > Advanced > Custom keyboard shortcuts: Enable, then a 'Keyboard Shortcuts' tab with one key per action).
userBindings.entryShape: Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts tab: one row per action (e.g. 'Archive') with a text field holding the key; 'One key can refer to only one action' (S1).
userBindings.keyNameMap: Single characters as typed; uppercase letters mean Shift+letter; '#' = Shift+3, '!' = Shift+1 on US layouts.
userBindings.readMode: Not readable locally and no documented API exposes it. The PI asks once ('Are Gmail keyboard shortcuts on?' with the ? key + Enable link as the fix) and lets the user type any custom keys; verbs join on appAction (Gmail's action name).

layouts.rationale: Triage on top (archive and delete are hold-to-confirm), star/unread/snooze and select/label/search in the middle, undo and inbox/sent jumps at the bottom; the left dial walks conversations (push opens).
Triage and compose/search on top, star/unread/undo/inbox below; conversation walker, page, tabs and zoom on the dials.

sources.title: Keyboard shortcuts for Gmail (Computer)
sources.note: States that the Actions, Jumping, Threadlist selection, Navigation and Application shortcuts 'won't work unless keyboard shortcuts are turned on'; documents custom shortcuts under Settings > Advanced.

sources.title: Prism browser research: titles, unread counts, privacy (sections 3.2, 10)

conflicts: S1 lists 'Archive conversation and go previous/next' as '] or [' without saying which key goes which way; left out until tested.
gaps: Whether the user has Gmail keyboard shortcuts on is unknowable from outside the page; every single-key verb shows a 'turn on shortcuts' badge until the user confirms in the PI.
Thread and compose detection (URL hash / ?compose=) are unverified; inline replies may not change the URL.

Window-title fallback is unverified (no signed-in session); Gmail titles contain the account address and subjects, so tabTitle is streamer-hidden and mail domains are always-hidden in the extension (S2 §10).
P / N (previous/next message in a conversation) are listed in S1's compose section without the 'needs shortcuts on' note; behavior with shortcuts off not tested.
Punctuation keys (#, !, *) are US-layout positions; other layouts need a per-locale map.

Single-key verbs type their letter if a text field has focus (an inline reply box, the search box). The compose context is deliberately NOT a child of list, so list verbs never apply while composing; inline replies that don't change the URL are the remaining risk.
notes: Safety: archive, delete, spam and send are confirm (hold). None is never-auto, so a user macro can still run them after the hold; the engine must never let AI or schedules run them (treat as never-auto for automation).
